column1: fog|/fɒɡ/|天气季节|n. 雾|The thick fog makes the road hard to see today.|今天浓雾让马路很难看清。
snowy|/ˈsnəʊi/|天气季节|adj. 下雪的|It is a snowy morning and the ground is white.|这是个下雪的早晨，地面一片白。
cloudy|/ˈklaʊdi/|天气季节|adj. 多云的|The cloudy sky hides the sun behind grey clouds.|多云的天空把太阳藏在灰云后。
breeze|/briːz/|天气季节|n. 微风|A cool breeze blows through the green leaves gently.|凉爽的微风轻轻吹过绿叶。
chef|/ʃef/|职业|n. 厨师|The chef cooks a big dinner in the busy kitchen.|厨师在忙碌厨房做丰盛晚餐。
dentist|/ˈdentɪst/|职业|n. 牙医|The dentist checks my white teeth every year.|牙医每年检查我的白牙。
firefighter|/ˈfaɪəfaɪtə(r)/|职业|n. 消防员|The brave firefighter saves a cat from the tree.|勇敢的消防员从树上救下猫。
policeman|/pəˈliːsmən/|职业|n. 警察|The friendly policeman helps the lost child find home.|友善的警察帮迷路孩子回家。
garden|/ˈɡɑːdn/|地点|n. 花园|We plant red flowers in the small garden at home.|我们在家的小花园种红花。
zoo|/zuː/|地点|n. 动物园|The children visit the zoo to see the panda.|孩子们去动物园看熊猫。
farm|/fɑːm/|地点|n. 农场|The farmer keeps cows and sheep on his farm.|农夫在农场养牛和羊。
lake|/leɪk/|地点|n. 湖|We sit by the quiet lake and watch the ducks.|我们坐在安静湖边看鸭子。
soon|/suːn/|时间|adv. 不久|The bus will come soon at the corner of street.|公交车不久会在街角开来。
noon|/nuːn/|时间|n. 中午|We eat lunch together at noon in the school.|我们中午在学校一起吃午饭。
dawn|/dɔːn/|时间|n. 黎明|The birds start to sing at dawn near the window.|鸟儿黎明时在窗边开始歌唱。
time|/taɪm/|时间|n. 时间|We have no time to play before the class starts.|上课前我们没时间玩了。
ship|/ʃɪp/|交通|n. 轮船|The big ship sails slowly across the blue sea.|大轮船在蓝海上缓缓航行。
boat|/bəʊt/|交通|n. 小船|We ride a small boat on the calm lake at noon.|中午我们在平静湖上划小船。
taxi|/ˈtæksi/|交通|n. 出租车|My father takes a taxi to the airport today.|爸爸今天坐出租车去机场。
subway|/ˈsʌbweɪ/|交通|n. 地铁|We go to school by subway every busy morning.|每个忙碌早晨我们坐地铁上学。
scarf|/skɑːf/|衣物|n. 围巾|She wears a red scarf in the cold winter snow.|她在寒冷冬雪里戴红围巾。
skirt|/skɜːt/|衣物|n. 短裙|The girl buys a new skirt at the small shop.|女孩在小店买了新短裙。
sweater|/ˈswetə(r)/|衣物|n. 毛衣|He puts on a warm sweater on the cold day.|冷天他穿上暖和毛衣。
jacket|/ˈdʒækɪt/|衣物|n. 夹克|My blue jacket keeps me warm in the wind.|蓝夹克在风里给我保暖。
glove|/ɡlʌv/|衣物|n. 手套|She wears a pair of red gloves in the snow.|她在雪里戴一双红手套。
love|/lʌv/|情感|v. 爱；喜欢|I love my little dog and play with it daily.|我爱我的小狗，每天和它玩。
hate|/heɪt/|情感|v. 讨厌|He hates the loud noise from the busy street.|他讨厌繁忙街道的喧闹。
bored|/bɔːd/|情感|adj. 无聊的|The bored boy looks out of the window at noon.|无聊的男孩中午望着窗外。
calm|/kɑːm/|情感|adj. 平静的|The calm lake reflects the blue sky so clearly.|平静的湖面清晰映出蓝天。
scared|/skeəd/|情感|adj. 害怕的|The scared child holds the mother hand tight.|害怕的孩子紧紧抓着妈妈的手。
